title: Secret Machines adviser: genocides may be a function of the phenomenon

tellings.quote: What I find very interesting is in the Secret Machines books, the non-fiction, you've got one of the advisers just outright telling Lavenda and DeLonge, you know, "Genocides may be a function of the phenomenon. It may be trying to eliminate certain genetic strands for its own purposes."

plain: Jason Samosa, a UFO researcher, points to Sekret Machines, a series of non-fiction books written by the musician Tom DeLonge and the author Peter Levenda with input from military and intelligence advisers. He says that in those books one adviser told them outright that genocides may be a function of the phenomenon, which might be trying to eliminate certain genetic lines for its own purposes. If true, it would mean whatever lies behind UFOs has a dark hand in human history.
